verdict.rationale: No native bulk export or offboarding feature is documented. The only route out is the REST API, which claims parity with the web client ('perform all the operations that you do with our web client', every resource exposed as a URL) and has a downloadable OpenAPI spec, so data could in principle be pulled programmatically as JSON. That extraction is also constrained by the documented rate limits of 100 requests per minute and per-plan daily caps. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all data, explicit open file formats (CSV/JSON/XLSX), account closure or data-deletion guidance, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete export.
